question: Can public history inference replace privileged target read under exactly matched physical pre-query command/state and identical post-query state container and native compiler?
truth_schedule: (seed-1)%4, eight per pattern per task; hidden from method inputs
policy: Two unmodified external frozen PPO checkpoints with verified SHA256
matched_prefix: Both matched arms physically dispatch same 6D commands on steps t2 and t3 and same neutral t4 probe, and pre-t5 achieved and native target SE3 are audited <=5e-5
shared_postquery_compiler: Both use UncertainDeliveryBelief, one identical base.normalized_target_delta(approximate=True,old_override=single_hypothesis) and prepare/acknowledge; only information at t5 differs, public unique allowed history else charged read versus fixed charged read
compiler_trace: Record every compiled post-t5 action, policy-native source proposal, prior belief pose and charged private reads. Compiled commands need not match if policy observations/information differ.
primary_endpoints: paired native task success on entire prospective 64 seeds
public versus matched fixed target-private read counts
all public confident correct and wrong admissions audit
physical prefix parity and common postquery implementation
complete negative and early exits retained
interpretation_limits: No external independent replication, superiority significance, formal noninferiority, actual network packet loss, safety or VLA claims
Physical truth getters strictly audit-only except counted explicit reads
Post-t5 physical state can diverge as a legitimate consequence of different information
No after-results metric or threshold tuning
